 ## Deploying your own models
 
-- [Serverless](https://fal.ai/docs/documentation/serverless): Deploy a Python app on fal's GPUs, billed differently from the Model APIs
-- [Compute](https://fal.ai/docs/documentation/compute): GPU containers, runners, and scaling
+fal Serverless runs your own model, pipeline, or HTTP server on the same GPU infrastructure that serves the Model APIs, autoscaling from zero to thousands of runners. Install the CLI with `pip install fal`, write a `fal.App` class that declares its machine type and endpoints, test it with `fal run`, and ship it with `fal deploy`; the result is an endpoint you call with the same clients and queue as any model above. An existing Docker image or HTTP server deploys with minimal changes. Serverless is billed per second of runner time by machine type, not per output, and needs Serverless access enabled on the account, which you request from the dashboard.
